title: Wicked Ward
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Wicked Ward}}

'''Wicked Ward''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that prevents [[Energy shield#Start of Energy shield Recharge|energy shield recharge]] from being interrupted by damage if energy shield recharge began [[recently]], but reduces your base energy shield recharge rate from 33% to 20%.

==Mechanics==
Once energy shield recharge starts, either by not taking damage for a duration (2 seconds by default) or by effects that trigger energy shield recharge such as {{il|Xirgil's Crank}} or {{psl|Spellbreaker}}, recharge will not be interrupted by damage for 4 seconds. This effect persists for the full 4 seconds even if energy shield reaches full.

==Location==
Wicked Ward is located on the right side of the upper part of the tree, near the energy shield wheel for the [[Witch]].

{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* The Wicked Ward Keystone Passive Skill no longer grants “50% less Energy Shield Regeneration Rate” or “50% less Maximum total Energy Shield Recovery per Second from Leech”. This brings the recharge rate with Wicked Ward down to 19.8% per second, while before it would have been 20% with or without the keystone.
